title: Learning & Development Specialist (f/m/d)
description:
Help us grow our people. You will design and run learning programmes for a distributed company of 500 employees.

What you'll do
- Run learning needs analyses with team leads
- Design onboarding and role-specific learning paths, including e-learning in Articulate
- Facilitate workshops and train internal facilitators
- Manage the LMS catalogue and report completion and impact data

What you bring
- 3+ years in L&D, training or instructional design
- Practical experience with an LMS and authoring tools
- Experience evaluating training (Kirkpatrick or similar)
- Excellent English; the working language is English
